title: 通过投票对团队排名
summary: 每张选票给出全部队伍的名次，按各名次获得票数依次比较并排序队伍。
insight: 为每个字母统计它在每个位置出现的次数；比较两队时从第一名票数逐位比较，全部相同则字母序更小者优先。
pitfalls: 比较的是逐名次字典序而非总分
完全相同时按队名字母序
只有选票中出现的队伍参与输出

solutions.title: 名次频次排序
solutions.idea: 使用每队的名次票数向量作为降序排序键。
steps: 对第一张选票中的队伍排序，逐 position 比较票数降序
所有票数相同时按字符升序并拼接

code.java: class Solution { public String rankTeams(String[] votes){int size=votes[0].length();int[][] count=new int[26][size];for(String vote:votes)for(int i=0;i<size;i++)count[vote.charAt(i)-'A'][i]++;Character[] teams=new Character[size];for(int i=0;i<size;i++)teams[i]=votes[0].charAt(i);Arrays.sort(teams,(a,b)->{for(int i=0;i<size;i++){int difference=count[b-'A'][i]-count[a-'A'][i];if(difference!=0)return difference;}return Character.compare(a,b);});StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();for(char team:teams)answer.append(team);return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun rankTeams(votes:Array<String>):String{val size=votes[0].length;val count=Array(26){IntArray(size)};for(vote in votes)for(i in 0 until size)count[vote[i]-'A'][i]++;return votes[0].toList().sortedWith(Comparator{a,b->for(i in 0 until size){val difference=count[b-'A'][i]-count[a-'A'][i];if(difference!=0)return@Comparator difference};a.compareTo(b)}).joinToString("")} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string rankTeams(vector<string>& votes){int size=votes[0].size();int count[26][26]={};for(auto& vote:votes)for(int i=0;i<size;++i)++count[vote[i]-'A'][i];string teams=votes[0];sort(teams.begin(),teams.end(),[&](char a,char b){for(int i=0;i<size;++i)if(count[a-'A'][i]!=count[b-'A'][i])return count[a-'A'][i]>count[b-'A'][i];return a<b;});return teams;} };
